variants.specifics: Brackenford: A townsman points to Halvard in the Moot Hall, who sends the player against Red Corwin on Crow Hill.

herald.speaker: Townsman
herald.text: Well there goes the north gate again. Halvard's in the Moot Hall, I'm off for a drink.

opening.speaker: Halvard
opening.text:
Welcome to Brackenford, lad. Crow Hill -- cursed watchtower home of Red Corwin's gang! Hideout of the greedy bandits of the north road!

Clear the watchtower, find Corwin and face his whole gang -- the fight of your life. They rob the road and shoot the careless.

reminder.speaker: Halvard
reminder.text: You need to deal with Corwin now.

journal.text: Find a way into the Crow Hill watchtower.

variants.specifics: Skarn Delve: Mayor Vorlund sends the player down to Chief Engineer Dorvak at Thrum Landing over the Trolls in the deep shafts

herald.speaker: Garn
herald.text: Hello, friend. Mayor Vorlund is expecting you.

opening.speaker: Mayor Vorlund
opening.text:
Something is badly wrong under our mountain. I need you to go down to Thrum Landing. There you must seek Chief Engineer Dorvak.

He has requested our help in dealing with the recent swarming of Trolls in the deep shafts.

Take this lamp -- and gold. Visit the shop if you need more supplies. Then make haste.

The lift beyond the Counting House will take you to Thrum Landing.

reminder.speaker: Mayor Vorlund
reminder.text: I've nothing more to say to you, lad. Go now and help Chief Engineer Dorvak!

journal.text: Leave Skarn Delve and travel down to Thrum Landing.

variants.specifics: Gorrow: Wend points the player to Gwoll, who sends him into the Sunken Chapel to look for signs of Vorgul and the Mudmen

herald.speaker: Wend
herald.text: Don't lose hope now, stranger, Gwoll knows how to stop the Mudmen!

opening.speaker: Gwoll
opening.text: The entrance to the Sunken Chapel is in the last hut on the walk. See if Vorgul has been there. You'll know. And watch your step. Many of the floors have pits against thieves.

reminder.speaker: Gwoll
reminder.text: Enter the Sunken Chapel, lad! We must know if tales of Vorgul's raids are true. Hurry! Go down into the vaults and see if the Mudmen have already come.

journal.text: Search the Sunken Chapel for signs of Vorgul's doings.

variants.specifics: Karth Vael: Joss points the player to Commander Ostrag, who sends him to Pemmick in Orm against the Troll King Skorn of Mount Dreg.

opening.speaker: Ostrag
opening.text:
I'll go no further. Too many Troll eyes the closer we get to Mount Dreg.

Follow the river path to Orm.

Find my old comrade Pemmick. He'll lend you a hand if he can.

Stay on the path. Cliff beasts will bite hard should you stray. Watch yourself out there, lad.

reminder.speaker: Ostrag
reminder.text: Go on! Don't stand around gawking. Look lively.

journal.text: Find Pemmick's hut in the Village of Orm.

variants.specifics: Orlmere: A townsman Pim points to Mayor Brannoch, who sends the player after the two items needed against Zorvane's drowned dead.

herald.speaker: Pim
herald.text: That necromancer Zorvane would never have come to the lake if Rudge had still been here! Brannoch is the one to ask.

opening.speaker: Brannoch
opening.text:
Ah, you've arrived. Good. Your first task in Orlmere is very important.

Something strange is transpiring on the lake. Sightings of the drowned dead near the nets is growing every day.

My efforts to learn the cause have been fruitless. A mysterious fog clouds the water. You may be able to help.

Most of the old boathouse on the north shore has sat empty for many years. The ledgers say it holds two items which may be crucial to my search. The first is the Silver Gaff, the second is the Bell of Ashes.

If you can bring these objects to me, quickly, I hope they will help give me the answers I need.

reminder.speaker: Brannoch
reminder.text: No luck yet? Well, keep looking in the boathouse on the north shore. The gaff and bell must be secured immediately!

journal.text: Retrieve the Silver Gaff for Brannoch.

variants.specifics: Zorreth: Rector Ulbrin, sent word of by the Captain, wants his Book of Wards taken back from the Gargoyles in the Observatory.

herald.speaker: Fenn
herald.text: Make way! Rector Ulbrin wants to see you!

opening.speaker: Ulbrin
opening.text:
Welcome to Zorreth, brave Adventurer! The Captain told us to expect you!

The Gargoyles on the hill have gone mad! They swooped into the college and stole my Book of Wards! A student chased the dirty things into the Observatory, but has not come back.

Go to the Observatory east of here and take my book back from the Gargoyles. Come and see me when you are back. You will find me in my hall at the heart of the college.

reminder.speaker: Ulbrin
reminder.text: Those wretched Gargoyles are making too much mischief lately.

journal.text: Retrieve the Rector's Book of Wards from the Gargoyles.

variants.specifics: Kell Varn: Warden Odrin sends the player through the old mine tunnel into Zhurg's Hold after the Staff of Thaw

herald.speaker: Wenk
herald.text: Warden Odrin wants to see you -- that's a bad sign.

opening.speaker: Warden Odrin
opening.text:
Sorry about the cold, lad, but the old mine tunnel is the quietest way into Zhurg's Hold. Two Ogre sentries watch the entrance, and plenty more patrol inside.

You must bring back the Staff of Thaw, but Zhurg will not part with it willingly. This may turn nasty. But these scrolls will help.

reminder.speaker: Warden Odrin
reminder.text: Haste will be invaluable for slipping past the sentries. The Shield spell will help turn aside their clubs on your way back. Good luck and good speed.

journal.text: Sneak into Zhurg's Hold through the mine tunnel.

variants.specifics: Ashkar: Pogg points the player to Maldrek, who sends him to recover the Hammer of Kolgar from Drovak's Trolls; Brakk waits at the Foundry.

herald.speaker: Pogg
herald.text: Hey! Hey! Maldrek has been asking for you!

opening.speaker: Maldrek
opening.text:
The long road has tested your mettle well, lad. But there's no time to sit idle. You must now recover the Hammer of Kolgar, which the Trolls took from Brakk when they raided poor Ashkar!

With the Trolls marching and the Hammer in their hands, Drovak is most certainly behind it all. Brakk is waiting at the Foundry. Now, off with you!

reminder.speaker: Maldrek
reminder.text: Quickly, go and find Brakk! He wants a word with you.

variants.specifics: Tolmar Cross: Fitch points the player to Orsk, who sends him to Glumm Hollow to rescue Quillon from the Trolls.

herald.speaker: Fitch
herald.text: Welcome! I hear you're the one Orsk has been waiting for!

opening.speaker: Orsk
opening.text:
Blast! Where have you been, lad!? The Trolls swarmed the North Bridge and we'd have lost it to them if Quillon's fiery spells had not been hurled in at the last moment!

But in the thick of it, the brutes dragged Quillon off, leaving the broken bridge our smallest worry! The whole north road is in peril if Quillon is lost!

You must go where Quillon was taken, north to the Troll Den of Glumm Hollow! Bring Quillon back or we are doomed!

reminder.speaker: Orsk
reminder.text: I'm sure Quillon's in deep trouble! Move fast!

journal.text: Go to Glumm Hollow and free Quillon.

variants.specifics: Tosk: Lorra points the player to Ruddock, who sends him on to Hesk, Odrin's brother, a farmer.

herald.speaker: Lorra
herald.text: Well, well! You're certainly cleaner than the other travelers! Go see Ruddock by the pump when you're done saving the world.

opening.speaker: Ruddock
opening.text:
Here we are, lad, the village of Tosk. I can't safely escort you any farther.

Up this lane a little way you'll find the farm of Hesk, brother of Odrin the Miller. He's expecting you. I must go and so should you!

Tosk is counting on you.

reminder.speaker: Ruddock
reminder.text: Stop dawdling now. Better get going!

journal.text: Find Odrin's farmer brother, Hesk, who lives north of the barley.
